review:
Sharks with lasers. In space. When a Laser Shark activates, it fires up or diagonally, turning every paying symbol in its path wild, then becomes a wild itself.

Force Fields on three edges of the grid bounce the beams back, so one laser can zig-zag across the board – and hitting an existing wild adds a multiplier to it. The Killer Cosmos and Chompocalypse bonuses bring more sharks. 10,000x max, and the rebounds are great to watch.
